rtl_precheck.bench: tools/hbm_layer_vehicle/tb_sfu_grid.sv on ot_hgi_sfu_arithmetic_grid_m85 (sw2 master ot_hgi_sfu_core_split3.sv sha d223fe81...), Verilator 5.050, ot-epyc5
facts: behavioural VM with 1-edge read: every write lands at the right O address but operand A is the word of beat b+3 (index-ramp probe: O[0..15] <- A[48..63]); 0 lane faults
read latency 4: data bit-exact except the last 3 beats (fixed by TAIL rows) but 96 M1/Q fp faults (valid multiplies on non-data words): the lane / memory contract is NOT a plain latency

the real sfucore operand path is ot_hgi_sfu_static_engine: 4 input groups (one SRAM group per stream A..D, filled only by stage_* = VM prefetch through the bridge), 4 scalar registers (scalar_load/enable: the B / D broadcast must use them, a stride-0 VM read is not the hardware path) and a SEPARATE output group read only by drain_* -> a pass cannot read the previous pass result without drain -> VM -> prefetch into group C
addresses are operand-store local (LWB 15: 32,768 words, bad_range fault above), not VM addresses
